description: Since defk-9vl kernels have Enum.reduce_while / all? / any?. fuzzy_search's Levenshtein would naturally stop a word once a row's minimum exceeds the current k-th best distance. Add that cutoff to BOTH the defk kernel and the Elixir backend (same algorithm, per AGENTS.md fair comparisons), optimise the Elixir side first, and re-measure. Coordinate with defk-klw (fuzzy_search defk vs blocking re-measure) so the baseline numbers are from a quiet machine.

comments.text: Triage (defk-sgw plan): ready-for-agent for the implementation in both backends; the quiet-machine re-measure belongs with defk-klw (ready-for-human).

title: Fair early-exit Levenshtein cutoff in fuzzy_search
